summary.headline: Entry-level customer support candidate
summary.body: Motivated and reliable candidate with hands-on experience helping customers, organizing daily tasks, and learning new tools quickly. Comfortable communicating clearly, solving practical problems, and contributing to a team environment.

experience.description: Helped visitors find information, answered basic questions, and supported organizers during a local career event.
highlights: Guided attendees to the correct registration and information points
Kept shared materials organized during a busy public event
Communicated politely with people from different backgrounds

experience.description: Provided informal help to classmates and neighbors with basic computer tasks and online forms.
highlights: Stayed patient when people needed repeated guidance

education.description: Completed general coursework with an interest in communication, technology, and practical problem solving.

assumptions.reason: Combined customer-facing volunteer work and informal computer help into a concise entry-level positioning statement.
Grouped user-provided abilities into simple categories suitable for the single MVP CV template.

warnings.message: Some experience details are informal or incomplete, so the draft avoids adding employers, dates, or metrics that were not provided.
The user should review the summary and experience wording before exporting the final CV.
